avoidProducts.name: Notion help articles for connecting other products to Notion agents
avoidProducts.why: End-user help articles about connecting a third-party product (here Snowflake) to Notion's agents; they describe that product's OAuth setup, not the Notion API's
avoidProducts.evidence: Baseline run 2026-10-29: 64 of 66 Sourced claims in the Notion guide cite www.notion.com/zh-cn/help/set-up-the-snowflake-mcp-for-notion, a page that begins 'Learn how to connect Snowflake to a Custom Agent or your Notion Agent' (apps/api/evals/diagnosis.md, section 7)

notes: Notion has no scope strings. Access is set by capabilities chosen at creation, so the real list holds capability names. Please confirm this treatment of scopes.
The avoidProducts entry was added after the first baseline run showed the agent building a guide from a Snowflake connector help article. It was not in the golden set approved on 2026-10-29.
